verdict.rationale: USPTO is a public web service whose documentation could reasonably offer llms.txt or agent-oriented docs, so the axis applies. Probes found no such surface: llms.txt returned 404, the Markdown docs variant returned 404, every OpenAPI candidate path returned 404, and the developer portal serves only a JavaScript app shell that a plain keyless fetch cannot read. The existence of api.uspto.gov and mentions of direct API calls are adjacent and do not amount to agent-oriented documentation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
